headline: DPP standards published as battery passport and packaging rules advance
summary: Two new EU standards have established data security and access protocols for Digital Product Passports under ESPR. Meanwhile, industry testing for battery passports progresses ahead of 2027 requirements, and the Council has agreed its negotiating stance on packaging rule simplifications.

items.title: EU standards published for Digital Product Passport data security
items.what: Two new EU standards have been developed to specify data security protocols and access control mechanisms for Digital Product Passports under the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation.
items.meaning: Technical specifications for product passports are taking shape. Your Chinese manufacturing partners will need to align their data architecture with these security and access standards.
items.action: Review supply chain IT and data infrastructure against the new EU passport security standards.

sources.title: Digital Product Passport: Two New EU Standards for Data Security and Access Control

items.title: Battery passport pilot demonstrates industry compliance readiness
items.what: Jinko ESS has launched a battery passport pilot with the Global Battery Alliance to test compliance mechanisms under the EU Battery Regulation.
items.meaning: With battery passport obligations applying from February 2027, practical testing provides a model for technical data sharing across your proprietary battery platform.
items.action: Engage Chinese battery suppliers to ensure data collection aligns with emerging passport testing standards.

sources.title: Jinko ESS Pilots Battery Passport with the Global Battery Alliance, Accelerating Compliance with the EU Battery Regulation

items.title: Council agrees stance on packaging rule simplifications
items.what: The EU Council agreed its negotiating position on proposed simplifications to reduce administrative burdens for small packaging producers.
items.meaning: While focused on smaller entities, the Council's position signals how packaging documentation rules will settle for imported packaged power tools across EU markets.
items.action: Monitor trilogue negotiations to update supplier packaging compliance guidelines.

sources.title: Simplification: Council agrees negotiating stance to cut red tape for small packaging producers

items.title: Italy introduces national rules to combat unsubstantiated greenwashing claims
items.what: Italy introduced national rules targeting greenwashing, requiring explicit substantiation for environmental marketing claims on consumer products.
items.meaning: Enforcement against unverified claims is tightening across EU member states, impacting how tool efficiency, repairability, and battery performance are marketed.
items.action: Audit environmental claims on tool packaging and retail materials sold in Italy.

sources.title: Green Claims Under Scrutiny Italy’s New Rules On Greenwashing
